_comment: Weekly Accomplishments. Palia's week rolls over MONDAY 04:00 UTC (Sunday 11 PM Central in summer, 10 PM in winter). Anchored to UTC so daylight saving cannot drift it.
_types: manual = Baby ticks it. collect = counted from the log. mode 'items' sums quantities; mode 'events' counts matching log LINES - use events when one action drops a pile (one felled tree is one line carrying 17 wood). direction 'lost' counts things leaving the inventory (using fertilizer). starOnly counts only pickups carrying the (1*) star-quality flag.
_evidence: Every automatic entry was checked against 30 of Baby's real logs on 2026-08-19. Manual entries carry whyManual explaining what the log cannot see. Do not 'improve' a manual entry into an automatic one without new log evidence.

items.label: Cook 3 Meals with Friends
items.whyManual: The log never names or counts another player.

items.label: Catch 10 Fish with Friends
items.whyManual: The log never names or counts another player.

items.label: Hunt 10 Creatures with Friends
items.whyManual: The log never names or counts another player.

items.label: Mine 5 Nodes with Friends
items.whyManual: The log never names or counts another player.

items.label: Cook 10 Meals
items.note: Counts finished dishes arriving. Pulling a dish out of storage looks identical - needs the cook-three-dishes test.

items.label: Cook 3 Star Quality Meals
items.note: (1*) is confirmed to be the star flag: only 4.6% of pickups carry it and 65 items appear both ways.

items.label: Chop Down 10 Trees
items.note: One felled tree is ONE log line carrying 14-22 wood, so events are counted, not items.

items.label: Craft 5 Common Furniture
items.whyManual: Crafting logs as 'Crafted recipe 7342' - a numeric ID with no name and no rarity.

items.label: Craft 3 Uncommon Furniture
items.whyManual: Crafting logs a numeric recipe ID with no rarity.

items.label: Craft 1 Rare Furniture
items.whyManual: Crafting logs a numeric recipe ID with no rarity.

items.label: Use Fertilizer 30 Times
items.note: Using fertilizer removes it from inventory, so losses are counted. Moving fertilizer into storage would also count.

items.label: Hunt 30 Creatures
items.note: Every kill in the logs drops a hide, and one kill is one line. Looting several corpses at once undercounts slightly.

items.label: Hunt 5 Magical Creatures
items.whyManual: Nothing marks a creature as magical. The only 'magic' token in any log is itemtype_wood_magicwood.

items.label: Mine 20 Nodes
items.note: One node is one log line, so events are counted rather than ore.

items.label: Visit 15 Homes in Home Tours
items.whyManual: Home Tours leave no trace in the log at all.

items.label: React 5 Times While Touring
items.whyManual: Home Tours leave no trace in the log at all.
